name: DuckDuckGo Search API
description: DuckDuckGo search API for Python and the command line: DuckDuckGo web results with rank, title, link, snippet and source, plus the knowledge panel when DuckDuckGo shows one, as JSON or CSV. A web search step for LLM agents and RAG pipelines. Free and open source; no DuckDuckGo key or proxies needed.

commands.name: search
commands.help: DuckDuckGo web results for a query
commands.description: DuckDuckGo web results for a query: rank, title, link, snippet and source of each organic result, plus the knowledge panel and featured snippet when DuckDuckGo shows them.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What to search, e.g. "retrieval augmented generation".

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Region to search, as an ISO country code (us, gb, de...); with --lang it becomes DuckDuckGo's region code, e.g. us-en.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Language of the region, e.g. en, de, fr.
